items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”当前对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均通过其对应包装类的compare方法进行比较。
